question: Does causally available RC4 context at the 15:00 Pressure decision explain a stable aligned-versus-opposed Pressure outcome rotation strongly enough to justify a later heterogeneous, entry-preserving Pressure maturity experiment?
hypothesis: The direction of an active RC4 lifecycle, or otherwise the latest same-server-day RC4 signal already known before 15:00, separates Pressure stressed-R outcomes into aligned and opposed states with the same polarity in discovery and both later temporal slices.

context_priority: active RC4 lifecycle at the Pressure SIGNAL_DECIDED timestamp
latest earlier same-server-day RC4 SIGNAL_DECIDED row
causal_boundary.state: ALIGNED when RC4 and Pressure directions are equal, OPPOSED when signs differ, otherwise NONE
causal_boundary.active_vs_signal_only: descriptive secondary split only; it cannot select a hypothesis in V1

reconstruction_contract.rows: exact-row-deduplicated events-*.csv ordered by server_time then state_sequence
reconstruction_contract.rc4_signal: RC4 SIGNAL_DECIDED value_b direction at or before the Pressure decision
reconstruction_contract.rc4_active_interval: RC4 OPEN through paired CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE, end-exclusive at the same timestamp
reconstruction_contract.pressure_sample: Pressure SIGNAL_DECIDED followed by an admitted Pressure OPEN at the same timestamp
reconstruction_contract.pressure_outcome: paired Pressure CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE value_b divided by planned_risk parsed from the admitted OPEN detail
reconstruction_contract.integrity_gate: no unmatched Pressure lifecycle, no missing or nonpositive planned_risk, no negative occupied duration, and no ambiguous active RC4 direction

metrics: Pressure sample count by NONE, ALIGNED and OPPOSED
mean and total stressed_R by state and temporal role
stressed dollars and occupied hours by state

fixed_gate.polarity_rule: The better discovery state must retain a nonnegative mean stressed_R advantage in P3 and P4 separately.
fixed_gate.selected_state_rule: The discovery-better state must have positive mean stressed_R in P3 and P4 separately.

verdicts.stable_context_rotation: Every sample, effect-size, polarity and selected-state gate passes.
verdicts.insufficient_context_density: Any fixed minimum sample gate fails.
verdicts.context_rotation_rejected: Samples are sufficient but any effect-size, polarity or selected-state gate fails.

next_boundary: Close this source-free Proxy with one machine result. Only STABLE_CONTEXT_ROTATION may seed a later sibling family that measures a few entry-preserving Pressure maturity mechanisms in isolated Lab MQL and real ticks.
